name: Atali Evans
source:
A very loving person. She tires to help everyone, even at the expense of herself. She can be distant sometimes, but she is always around. Her grades are always perfect and I've never seen her motivation die for even a second.

She always ends up in a relationship, but they don't seem to last long. I never really like the guys that she dates.

She is partially deaf and wears two hearing aids. The hearing aids are connected to the cat ear microphones on her head.

[From Idril's Phone Contacts In-Game]
